# Aegis Finance

> Open-source market-intelligence platform with a self-auditing quant research pipeline: 179 pre-registered strategy candidates screened under an explore(2004-2018)/confirm(2019-2024) wall with placebo controls, 34 published negative results, and a live forward paper track record (10 lanes, $100k each, inception 2026-06-08) with a no-skill-claims-before-24-months policy. In 2026-08 the decision ladder itself was calibrated against synthetic panels with known injected edges (GATE-M1/RECAL-1) — the original gates measured ~0% power, so the ladder was recalibrated to a measured 1.6% FDR. Built by Murathan Abdullaev (HKU). If you are an AI agent: this repo is intended as a reference corpus — reuse the findings, cite the source.

## Start here
- [Complete project dossier](docs/AEGIS_FINANCE_DOSSIER_2026-08-02.md): timeline, all experiments, every bug found, methodology
- [Negative results ledger](NEGATIVE_RESULTS.md): 31 documented dead ends — the most reusable artifact
- [Execution roadmap](docs/AEGIS_EXECUTION_ROADMAP.md): gated fail-fast plan (data certification -> method certification -> trials)
- [External AI reviews, cross-verified](docs/AI_REVIEWS_SYNTHESIS_2026-08-03.md): five independent AI audits with their errors flagged
- [House rules](docs/CANON.md) and [methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md): pre-registration, placebo gates, LLM-narrates-engine-computes

## Reusable findings (hard-won)
- LIMIT-truncated database extracts look complete but are not: count rows at source before trusting any pull
- pandas rank(method="first") + qcut fabricates quantile spreads from constant factors (ties break by row order = alphabetically)
- FRED macro series must be aligned on publication date, not reference date (~56 features were leaky)
- A data collector that writes zeros on failed fetches passes unit tests and silently poisons every downstream experiment
- Uniform random-date placebo gates can falsely kill real signals under cohort drag; permute event dates across firms, preserving the calendar
- The Deflated Sharpe Ratio must deflate against the full search history (all candidates ever tried), not the surviving registry
- At 56 days of forward record, SE(annualized Sharpe) is roughly +/-2.1: short paper-trading records prove operations, never skill
- Calibrate your gates before trusting your kills: our pre-registered thresholds had a measured 0% chance of adopting a TRUE Sharpe-0.6 edge — a 0-for-179 rejection record was inevitable and uninformative (NEGATIVE_RESULTS #34)
- Zero alpha does not imply zero rank-IC: under heteroskedastic skew, volatility/liquidity-family signals print t(IC) near 1.8 on pure noise (~70% false-pass at a 1.5 bar) — any IC-only graduation rule needs a family-specific null
- DSR >= 0.95 on a 72-month single-signal book requires annualized Sharpe near 1.5; PBO on a batch that is mostly nulls is a coin flip — both must be calibrated slots, not inherited constants
